_note: Texts and colours of the final product (product_app.py). Edit freely; the page reloads them on every visit. Colours: a colour-blind-checked set (rep blocks on the light timeline, dots on white) - every rep block also carries the error's short name. abnormal_tempo is kept only for old sessions; the model has the six classes listed. "view" = default camera for that error: front, side, back, rear (three-quarter from behind) or top.

correct.name: Correct
correct.what: Good rep: full depth, stable trunk, knees tracking over the toes, heels down, controlled tempo.
correct.why: This is the pattern to repeat.
fix: Use these reps as your reference when you compare reps.
correct.focus: Keep this technique on every rep.

insufficient_depth.name: Insufficient depth
insufficient_depth.what: The hips do not reach knee height at the bottom of the squat.
insufficient_depth.why: A shallow squat trains only part of the range and puts more of the load on the knees instead of the hips.
fix: Sit back and down; aim for thighs at least parallel to the floor.
Widen your stance slightly and turn the toes out a little.
Work on ankle mobility; practise to a box to learn the depth.

forward_lean.name: Forward lean
forward_lean.what: The trunk tips too far forward during the squat.
forward_lean.why: Excess lean shifts the load to the lower back and makes it harder to keep the spine neutral.
fix: Chest up and brace the core before you descend.
Keep the weight over mid-foot; let the knees travel forward.
Strengthen the upper back (rows, face pulls).
forward_lean.focus: Keep the chest up and the trunk more upright.

knee_valgus.name: Knee valgus
knee_valgus.what: The knees cave inward, towards each other.
knee_valgus.why: Inward collapse strains the inside of the knee and the ligaments (ACL, MCL).
fix: Push the knees out over the toes; "spread the floor" with your feet.
Strengthen the hip abductors (band walks, clamshells).
Keep the weight over the whole foot.
knee_valgus.focus: Push the knees out over the toes.

knee_varus.name: Knee varus
knee_varus.what: The knees bow outward past the toes.
knee_varus.why: Outward bowing loads the outside of the knee and the ankle unevenly.
fix: Keep the knees in line with your second toe; do not force them out.
Check your stance width and toe angle.
knee_varus.focus: Track the knees in line with the second toe.

heel_lift.name: Heel lift
heel_lift.what: The heels leave the floor during the squat.
heel_lift.why: Lifting the heels moves the weight to the toes and the front of the knees and makes you unstable.
fix: Keep the weight on the heels and mid-foot.
Temporarily use a small heel raise; try a slightly wider stance.
heel_lift.focus: Keep the heels on the floor.

abnormal_tempo.name: Abnormal tempo
abnormal_tempo.what: The rep is too fast, too slow or uneven (for example dropping into the bottom).
abnormal_tempo.why: Uncontrolled speed reduces control at the bottom of the squat, where the joints are loaded most.
fix: Descend in about 2-3 s, pause briefly, rise smoothly.
abnormal_tempo.focus: Control the tempo: about 2-3 s down, smooth up.

saliency_help: The colour shows where on the body this error shows (a painted map per error) and when the model paid most attention during the rep (brighter = more attention). It explains what the model looked at; it is not a medical diagnosis.
